messages:
deploy-bot: publish blocked for repo=redwood/services/ingest tag=2026-03-21-rc3
deploy-bot: reason=manifest-list platform labels mismatch (manifest expects order [amd64, arm64], registry show [arm64, amd64]) -- rejecting to avoid ambiguous pulls
rachel_rm: seeing this in the release window, ugh. is this failing the automated promote?
sam_oncall: yes, deploybot refused the promote step a minute ago. Canary hasn't been promoted.
liam_sre: any recent changes to buildkite or the multi-arch pipeline?
meena_ci: pushed a tweak last night to sort platforms by build order — maybe that reordered entries. I can revert the change but need a quick plan for the release window.
jonah_devex: quick options: (1) pin the rollout to the previous digest (manual promote), (2) retag and republish a manifest with corrected platform order, (3) abort window and roll back release notes + cherry-picks.
aisha_prod: customers on the canary include two enterprise teams — we should avoid abort if possible. Manual pin sounds fastest.
rachel_rm: I vote manual pin to previous digest and continue the window. We'll note changelog for republish post-window. Sam, can you do the manual promote?
sam_oncall: I can. Which digest? deploy-bot shows last success digest sha256:8a3f2b... (from 2026-03-20 22:10 UTC). Confirming promote command: `/deploybot promote redwood/services/ingest@sha256:8a3f2b --to=prod --note="pin previous good build due to manifest ordering"`
meena_ci: I'll also queue a republish job to publish a corrected manifestlist to staging after the change window, but keep it gated until we finish the window.
liam_sre: pls also add a deploybot exception so automated checks don't re-reject the manual promote. We should record the exception id in the release notes.
jonah_devex: can we add a short preflight check in buildkite to validate manifest platform list ordering? I'll open a PR post-window.
aisha_prod: I'll update the release notes: mention patched manifest to be republished and that we pinned to previous digest for safety.
rachel_rm: OK action list: Sam manual promote now, Liam create exception ticket and link to release thread, Meena run republish after window, Jonah PR for preflight, Aisha update notes. Everyone reaction if you ack. :thumbsup:
sam_oncall: done — promoted to prod and added note. exception ticket created: INFRA-1629
meena_ci: queued republish to staging (job 4527), holding until window closes.
liam_sre: INFRA-1629 linked to release thread and to deploybot audit.
jonah_devex: PR opened: buildkite/checks#784 — adds manifest-order lint step.
aisha_prod: release notes updated and pushed to docs site.
rachel_rm: thanks team. We'll run a short postmortem after the window to discuss preventing this kind of ordering sensitivity. Marking thread resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
